tasks.subject: Task 1: read_wheel_metadata helper
tasks.description:

tasks.subject: Task 2: index and extract-meta subcommands
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `ghr-pypi index` is today's command; `ghr-pypi extract-meta PATH...` writes .metadata sidecars; bare `ghr-pypi` prints help.

**Verify:** just test

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/ghr_pypi/cli.py", "tests/test_cli.py"], "verifyCommand": "just test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["index behaves as before", "bare ghr-pypi prints help, exits non-zero", "paths and dirs, non-recursive", "sidecar written and overwritten", "five error cases exit 1", "no paths exits non-zero", "mutation-proven"]}
```
